page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for intensive parallel computing workloads. It features 24 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration provides 24 physical cores with a single thread per core under a shared allocation model. The system is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, yielding 20.0 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs providing a combined 160 GB of VRAM.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong memory and decompression performance. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only small block cached speeds of 4086.55 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds of 110.72 GB/sec, both placing in the top 25%. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression reached 15.63 GB/sec, placing it in the top 10% tier. For specialized workloads, the server achieves top-tier LLM inference speeds with a small 135M model, processing prompts at 10457.59 tokens/sec and generating text at 366.07 tokens/sec. Passmark CPU testing yielded a score of 55980.84, while database operations reached 24760.33, both indicating strong performance.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers a high ratio of memory and GPU acceleration relative to its vCPU count, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that bottleneck on VRAM or system memory rather than raw CPU cycles. However, architectural tradeoffs include a shared CPU allocation model and the complete absence of local storage, meaning external storage solutions must be attached. The CPU also operates at a base speed of 2.0 GHz, resulting in average single-core and multi-core stress-ng performance.

This hardware profile is suited for large language model inference, deep learning training, data science pipelines, and memory-intensive database operations. The inclusion of Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 instructions further supports vectorized execution and cryptography tasks.
description: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 24 vCPUs on an Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processor, 480.0 GB of system memory, and two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with 160 GB of total VRAM. Operating on a KVM hypervisor, the instance features a shared CPU allocation model and lacks local storage. Benchmarks show top-tier performance in bzip3 decompression and LLM inference, with prompt processing reaching 10457.59 tokens/second for a small model. Memory bandwidth is strong, with cached small-block reads at 4086.55 GB/second. While single-core CPU benchmarks are average, the presence of Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 instructions enhances matrix and vector calculations. This instance is suited for machine learning inference, deep learning, and memory-heavy database operations where GPU acceleration and high memory capacity are required.
